description: This file defines the NotificationData class, a Java data transfer object (DTO) used for representing notification-related information within the Apache Fineract project. The class includes various fields such as id, objectType, objectId, action, actorId, content, read status, system-generated flag, tenantIdentifier, creation date, officeId, and a set of userIds.

classes.name: NotificationData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing notification details, implementing Serializable for persistence and transfer purposes.
